invariants: Every mutation names and matches one run, exact task revision, worker, session, lease identifier, and lease fence.
Events are atomic, bounded, privacy-safe, ordered, and SHA-256 hash linked; restart validates the complete chain.
Interrupt, resume, and cancel are requests until a runtime observation confirms their outcome.
Resume requires the exact observed checkpoint; recovery requires that checkpoint, an expired prior lease, a new worker, and a newer lease fence.
Accounting consumption plus remaining budget equals the original budget; artifact IDs and digests are unique.
Board events retain bounded Coordinator/AWQ/AWG/UI outcomes, failure codes, checkpoint digests, and historical worker/session/lease mappings.
Accepted requires Coordinator done plus AWQ accepted, AWG approved, and UI completed observations.
Unknown remote outcomes remain unknown; this interface performs no provider, credential, or network operation.
